defect: hardened counter state uses blocking assignment in its clocked process
rationale: The sequential count state is updated with blocking assignments, which makes clocked simulation ordering differ from the intended register behavior and violates sequential coding intent.

mutation.description: Changed both reset and increment assignments for the counter state to blocking assignments.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the hardened counter to reset, increment, and registered count state.

labels.note: blocking assignment to state in clocked block
